mapper.select: select user_password from sys_user where 1=1 and user_id = #{userId}

select sys_id , plant_nm as store_name , address , phone_number , emergency_phone_number , (select email from sys_user where user_id = #{userId}) as email , open_time , close_time from sys_plant sp where 1=1
and sp.plant_nm like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
and sp.plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and sp.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: update sys_plant set plant_nm = #{updateItems.storeName} , address = #{updateItems.address} , phone_number = #{updateItems.phoneNumber} , emergency_phone_number = #{updateItems.emergencyPhoneNumber} , email = #{updateItems.email} , open_time = #{updateItems.openTime} , close_time = #{updateItems.closeTime} , modify_datetime = now(), modify_user_id = #{userId} where 1=1 and sys_id = #{updateItems.sysId}
mapper.select: select sys_id , plant_nm as store_name , address , phone_number , emergency_phone_number , null as email , open_time , close_time from sys_plant sp where 1=1 and sp.sys_id = #{sysId} and sp.delete_yn = 'N'
